name: Mouth opening / jaw relaxation

lead: This is a no-equipment habit: let the jaw drop and move freely while speaking.
People use it for clearer articulation and a more relaxed face.

paras: Releasing jaw tension lets the mouth open wider and move more easily during speech.
No documented risks; persistent jaw pain is usually something to raise with a clinician.

chain: Clearer articulation and a more relaxed face
angle.text: Practitioners say a relaxed, freely opening jaw makes speech clearer and expression more natural.

lead: Mouth opening and jaw relaxation refers to the practice of consciously releasing tension in the jaw and opening the mouth fully and smoothly, often to improve articulation and speech clarity. People use it so words are enunciated more clearly and the face looks less tense when speaking.

Relaxing the jaw is also discussed in looksmaxxing circles as part of a softer, more open facial posture. Published sources on the practice as a looks technique are sparse; it overlaps with general speech and voice coaching.

paras: The practice involves allowing the lower jaw to drop and move without clenching while talking, so vowels and consonants have room to form. It is commonly taught in speech and singing contexts.
Community members describe it as a free adjustment to how they speak and carry their face.
